Kit summary

Gleaming Vine ThornActive
Deals 160% ATK DMG to all enemies and steals 1 buff layer from each. At the end of the turn of the enemy with the highest initial SPD, casts Gleaming Vine Thorn once.
Vineheart Crown Lv.3After an enemy casts a skill, Olenna steals 20% Turn Meter from the enemy with the highest Turn Meter among the other enemies (once before her action). After an enemy receives a Turn Meter increase, she likewise steals 20% Turn Meter from the highest-Turn-Meter other enemy (once before her action).
Verdant Vine ShelterActive
Verdant Vine Shelter: grants Verdant Ward (immune to a control effect, up to 3 times) to the highest initial ATK ally and the highest HP ally for 2 turns, then deals 340% ATK DMG to all enemies. Resonance version: grants all allies Verdant Rejuvenation for 2 turns (damage-deducted HP reduced by 30% and converted into a value settled evenly over her next 2 turns), then deals 340% ATK HP Deduction DMG to all enemies.
Vineheart Crown Lv.1Cast once at the start of battle. Each time Olenna is immune to a control effect, all allies gain 10% Turn Meter (up to 2 times before her action). When an ally with the Loong's Wrath tag gains Verdant Ward, it gains +30% Mastery and +10% Turn Meter when attacked by enemy proactive skills (once before her action).
Vineheart Crown Lv.2After casting Verdant Vine Shelter · Resonance, casts Parasitic Bloom once. After casting Parasitic Bloom · Resonance, casts Verdant Vine Shelter once.
Vineheart ResonancePassive
Max 10 Resonance Points. Gains 1 when an ally's turn ends. At max, acts for 1 extra turn and enters Resonance Enhancement for 2 turns (immune to control, 10% DMG Reduction, cannot gain points). Entering it reduces the CD of Verdant Vine Shelter and Parasitic Bloom by 1 turn, and the next proactive cast of one of them is replaced with its Resonance version.
Vineheart Crown Lv.2While in Resonance Enhancement she can gain Resonance Points (each ally can trigger this once before their action). When an ally inflicts Loong's Wrath, she gains 2 Resonance Points. At battle start, if she has the highest SPD among allies, gains 30% Turn Meter and enters Resonance Enhancement for 2 turns.
Parasitic BloomActive
Parasitic Bloom: inflicts Parasite on all enemies without Parasite · Resonance for 2 turns (records 30% of DMG taken and loses that HP at the start of the turn), then inflicts 1 layer of Loong's Wrath on all enemies for 2 turns and gives allies +10% Turn Meter. Resonance version: replaces Parasite with Parasite · Resonance for 2 turns (records 50% of DMG taken; loses that HP and restores 20% of it to the lowest HP enemy), and gives allies +20% Turn Meter.
Vineheart Crown Lv.3On a Boss, also inflicts Feebleness II and Paralyze II for 2 turns; the recorded DMG of Parasite/Parasite · Resonance on a Boss is at least 70%. Each Loong's Wrath ally reduces the DMG dealt by the target with Parasite · Resonance by 10% for 2 turns. Casting the Resonance version on a Loong's Wrath target consumes up to 3 layers to enhance it, each layer adding 10% to the recorded DMG.
Vineheart Crown (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
